ja253:1.1: Mam' annapānaṃ vipulaṃ uḷāraṃ uppajjatīmassa maṇissa hetu, tan te na dassaṃ, atiyācako si, na cāpi te assamaṃ āgamissaṃ.
ja253:2.1: Susū yathā sakkharadhotapāṇi tāses' imaṃ selaṃ yācamāno, tan te na dassaṃ, atiyācako si, na cāpi te assamaṃ āgamissan ti.
ja253:3.1: Na taṃ yāce yassa piyaṃ jigiṃse, desso hoti atiyācanāya, nāgo maṇiṃ yācito brāhmaṇena adassanaṃ yeva tad' ajjhagamā ti.
